h: NAFDAC uncovers suspected fake cosmetics operation at Lagos Trade Fair Complex
p: NAFDAC says it has uncovered a suspected illegal cosmetics production and packaging operation at the Trade Fair Complex in Lagos, finding unlabelled creams, falsified medicines and banned soaps.
body: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) has uncovered a suspected illegal cosmetics production and packaging operation in Lagos.

In a video shared on the agency's X account on Saturday, 14 November 2026, NAFDAC enforcement officials were seen inspecting a two-storey building in the tools and hardware section of the Trade Fair Complex. They displayed unlabelled cosmetics, empty product containers, packaging materials and finished creams found on different floors. Some packaging bore product descriptions such as turmeric and vitamin C, alongside empty shampoo tubes and lotion containers. The agency also reported finding falsified medicines and banned soaps.
The officials said the find raised concerns about cosmetics of unknown origin and regulatory status circulating in the market.
It was not immediately clear whether any arrests were made.
more: Unlabelled creams and packaging were found.
Falsified medicines and banned soaps were also seized.
It is unclear if anyone was arrested.
